title: Incursions in the city of Nauta

tellings.quote: in the jungle. They also happened in the city of Na.

plain: Strange incursions reported in the Peruvian jungle in 2023 also happened in the town of Nauta, Peru, not only out in the forest. Tim Alberino, an investigator who went to look into the reports, tells Michels this without naming a source. It matters to him because it means the encounters reached a populated place, not just remote jungle.
